about.missionText: Nida Al-Quran (The Call of the Quran) is dedicated to providing high-quality Islamic education for students of all ages. We are committed to creating an accessible, engaging, and spiritually enriching environment for learning the Quran and Islamic studies.
about.visionText: To be a leading center for Quran studies, nurturing a generation of students who understand, practice, and promote the beautiful teachings of Islam with wisdom and compassion. To cultivate Islamic leaders who bring positive change to society.
about.description1: Nida Al-Quran has been providing quality Islamic education for over 10 years. Located in Addis Ababa, we have successfully taught thousands of students the Quran, Arabic language, and Islamic studies.
about.description2: Our instructors are highly experienced and certified in their fields. By combining modern teaching methods with traditional Islamic education, we ensure that students develop a deep understanding and appreciation for Islamic teachings.
